cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode finite_spectral_shadows.tex >/tmp/fss.log 2>&1; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode finite_spectral_shadows.tex >/tmp/fss.log 2>&1
grep -E "^!" /tmp/fss.log | head -3; grep -c "Output written" /tmp/fss.log; pdfinfo finite_spectral_shadows.pdf | grep Pages
ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "dc_19 degenerate-minimum mass lemma TESTED (Monte Carlo, 2e6 pairs/config, c=5,6,7, m=c,c+2,2c; scripts c_suite/analysis/degmin_mass_audit.py + degmin_validate.py). Classifier (d_nom=min_i[i+v3(dC_i)]<=c-2 AND d_true(a)=v3(sum 3^i dC_i/((3^i a+C_i)(3^i a+C'_i)))>=c-1) VALIDATED vs exact complete sums at c=5,m=10: nondegenerate => machine zeros (max 1.5e-16), degenerate => |S|/phi in [0.5,1.0], 100% nonzero. VERDICT TWO-SIDED: (1) level-cost mechanism CONFIRMED exactly - P[d_true-d_nom>=k] = 0.07/0.02/0.007/0.0024 ~ 3^{-k} per level at every (c,m). (2) MASS LEMMA FALSE AS STATED: degenerate mass FLAT in m (prefix-local phenomenon, ~4.7/3.1/1.6 e-2 at c=5/6/7); matched-conditional rate rises from ~1/7 of unconditional at m=c to full decorrelation at m=2c; abs-value class bound 2phi*P[match AND deg] is NOT O(rho^m) - at m=2c it EXCEEDS the entire measured row sum by 14x/31x/77x (c=5/6/7). (3) RESCUE AT alpha=1: at m=c endpoint matching SUPPRESSES degeneracy (window/prefix overlap), class-IV mass = 2-4% of measured R_c, stable-to-decaying in c. STRATEGIC CONSEQUENCE: Schur bookkeeping must run at m=c (completeness threshold), empirical scale 1-delta~0.93 (R_c^{1/2c}=0.9547/0.9350/0.9280 descending); at alpha>=2 the degenerate class would itself need phase cancellation. Paper: audit paragraph + conj:schur commentary updated (alpha=1 pinned). dc_19's warning branch ('if false, Schur may fail') resolved: fails in mass form at large alpha, survives at alpha=1. 27pp clean." 2>&1 | tail -1
ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
